name: com.52choujiang/wechat-channels-insights
title: SocialDataX 微信视频号 WeChat Channels MCP
description: 微信视频号 / WeChat Channels MCP for hot search, video search, detail lookup, comments/replies, user profiles, user posted videos, and speech-to-text transcript.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key from SocialDataX / 社媒数据助手

tools.name: wechat_get_hot_search_list
tools.description: Get the current WeChat Channels / 微信视频号 hot search list.

tools.name: wechat_search_videos
tools.description: Search WeChat Channels videos by keyword with optional page_token continuation and filters; do not pass page.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_detail_by_encrypted_object_id
tools.description: Fetch structured video details when the caller already has an encrypted_object_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_detail_by_url
tools.description: Resolve a WeChat Channels video link or share text into structured video details.

tools.name: wechat_submit_video_speech_text_by_video_url
tools.description: Submit a WeChat Channels video speech-to-text transcript task from a video link or share text. 提交完成后最多短等 15 秒；if not finished, returns a job handle.

tools.name: wechat_submit_video_speech_text_by_encrypted_object_id
tools.description: Submit a WeChat Channels video speech-to-text transcript task from an encrypted_object_id. 提交完成后最多短等 15 秒；if not finished, returns a job handle.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_speech_text_job
tools.description: Check a WeChat Channels speech-to-text transcript job by job_id without starting a new task. This v1 surface returns transcript only, not summary.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_comments_by_object_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments when the caller already has the video object identifiers.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_comments_by_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments directly from a WeChat Channels video link or share text.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_comment_replies_by_comment_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated replies under a first-level comment by video object identifiers and comment_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_info_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch user profile data when the caller already has a user_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_posted_videos_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of videos published by a user when the caller already has a user_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_posted_videos_by_url
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of videos published by a user from a profile or video link.
